name: SUNVIEW
recent: Sunview 正在推进 Winstar Capital 22.44% 股权的分批出售，首 tranche 已于 10 月完成部分交割；同时 JSNT 收购的完成期限再度延后至 2027 年。公司也完成了最高 10% 私募配售的最后一 tranche，并有一宗涉及 Labuan 太阳能项目的诉讼。
notable: 完成向多名买方出售 Winstar Capital 22.44% 股权中的首批 31,860,834 股，作价每股 RM0.43，总代价约 RM13.70 million。
JSNT 收购的先决条件期限延长 175 天至 2027 年 3 月 31 日，完成日延至 2027 年 5 月 31 日或之前。
最高 10% 私募配售的第六及最后一 tranche 完成，5,935,910 股新股于 2026 年 9 月 7 日上市，发行价每股 RM0.3330。
risks: 公司就 Labuan 太阳能项目向法院申请追讨欠款，存在重大诉讼。
Winstar Capital 股权出售的第一 tranche 完成日期曾多次延后，最终部分交割。
私募配售新股发行可能对现有股东权益产生摊薄影响。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收为 RM104.822 million，环比增长 65.7%，同比增长 62.7%；净利为 RM0.095 million，环比下降 6.9%，同比下降 93.2%，净利率为 0.1%。

events.what: JSNT 收购先决条件截止

recent_en: Sunview is progressing the staggered disposal of its 22.44% stake in Winstar Capital, with part of the first tranche completed in October, while the completion deadline for the JSNT acquisition has been extended again to 2027. The company also completed the final tranche of a private placement of up to 10% and has a litigation matter involving a Labuan solar project.
notable_en: Completed the first batch of 31,860,834 Winstar Capital shares out of the 22.44% stake at RM0.43 per share, for total consideration of about RM13.70 million.
Extended the conditions precedent period for the JSNT acquisition by 175 days to 31 March 2027, with completion by 31 May 2027 or earlier.
Completed the sixth and final tranche of the private placement of up to 10%, with 5,935,910 new shares listed on 7 September 2026 at an issue price of RM0.3330 per share.
risks_en: The company has filed for court approval to recover sums owed from a Labuan solar project, constituting material litigation.
The first tranche completion date for the Winstar Capital disposal was extended multiple times before partial completion.
The issuance of new placement shares may dilute existing shareholders' equity.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM104.822 million, up 65.7% QoQ and 62.7% YoY; net income was RM0.095 million, down 6.9% QoQ and 93.2% YoY, with a net margin of 0.1%.
